mapper.sql: select id, self_id, follow_id, follow_type, tenant_code from micro_follow
mapper.insert:
insert into micro_follow (self_id, follow_id, follow_type, tenant_code) values
( #{item.selfId}, #{item.followId}, #{item.followType}, #{item.tenantCode} )
mapper.select:
SELECT t.itemId, t.itemCode, t.itemName, t.itemSeq FROM micro_follow mf inner join (
select mu.id as itemId, IF(mu.nick_name is null, mu.user_name,mu.nick_name) as itemName, '' as itemSeq, '' as itemCode, mu.tenant_code from micro_user mu
select mp.id as itemId, mp.product_name as itemName, mp.product_seq as itemSeq, mp.product_code as itemCode, mp.tenant_code from micro_product mp
select mpc.id as itemId, mpc.process_name as itemName, mpc.process_seq as itemSeq, mpc.process_code as itemCode, mpc.tenant_code from micro_process_common mpc
) as t on t.tenant_code = t.tenant_code and mf.follow_id = t.itemId where mf.follow_type =#{followType} AND mf.self_id = #{selfId} ORDER BY mf.id DESC
